_note: Probe sets for reconstructing SUBTLE-BODY MAPS from the sources themselves. Ten systems that independently chart centres, channels or loci on the human body. Probes are written in each system's own idiom, not in a common comparative vocabulary, so that retrieval does not presuppose the alignment we want to test. Chinese channel-and-point medicine is included deliberately as a CONTROL: it is a therapeutic map of the same body, built without an experiential-ascent claim, so it shows what a body map looks like when nobody is reporting inner states from it.

systems.label: Hindu tantric cakras
probes: the lotus at the base of the spine has four petals, and above it the six-petalled lotus
at the heart is the lotus of twelve petals, and at the throat the lotus of sixteen
between the eyebrows is the two-petalled lotus, and above all the thousand-petalled
in the navel wheel resides the element of fire, with its seed-syllable and presiding deity
each lotus has its letters upon the petals, its element, and its colour
meditate upon the wheel at the base, red as the rising sun, four-petalled

systems.label: Yogic channels and the serpent power
probes: the serpent power sleeping at the base awoke and rose through the central channel
the breath passes through ida and pingala, and when it enters sushumna the mind grows still
piercing the knot, the power ascended and I felt heat rise along the spine
the moon nectar drips from above the palate and is consumed by the sun at the navel
when the power reaches the crown the yogin knows bliss and the body becomes as if dead

systems.label: Tibetan channels, winds and wheels
probes: the central channel with the right and left channels beside it, running from the crown to below the navel
the wheel at the navel with sixty-four spokes, and the wheel at the heart with eight
the winds are gathered into the central channel and the drops are brought to the heart
at the crown is the wheel of great bliss, and the white drop descends from it
inner heat blazed at the navel and melted the drop at the crown

systems.label: Sufi subtle centres (laṭāʾif)
probes: the subtle centre of the heart lies on the left of the chest, and the spirit on the right
above the heart is the secret, and above that the hidden, and the most hidden
the seeker recites the name upon the heart until the centre becomes luminous
the self commanding to evil, the self that blames, and the self at peace
each subtle centre has its colour and its prophet, and its light appears to the traveller

systems.label: Daoist cinnabar fields and inner landscape
probes: the lower cinnabar field lies below the navel, the middle at the heart, the upper in the palace of the mud pill
the breath rises along the spine through the three passes to the summit and descends through the front
the spirit is refined into emptiness in the upper field, and the infant is born
the yellow court lies within, and the palaces of the body each have their spirit
guarding the One, the practitioner concentrates the breath at the field below the navel

systems.label: Kabbalistic sefirot on the body
probes: the sefirot correspond to the members of the body, the crown above the head
wisdom and understanding are the two brains, mercy and severity the two arms
beauty is the trunk of the body, foundation the sign of the covenant, kingdom the feet
the supernal man, and the arrangement of the limbs in the divine image
the soul has levels, nefesh in the liver, ruach in the heart, neshamah in the brain

systems.label: Theosophical chakras
probes: the etheric centres appear as whirling vortices upon the surface of the etheric double
the force flows into the centre and radiates in spokes, giving it the appearance of a flower
the centre at the base of the spine glows with fiery orange-red, the splenic with all colours
each chakra corresponds to a plane and to a sense, and to a gland of the physical body
the awakening of these centres before purification is exceedingly dangerous

systems.label: Hesychast prayer of the heart
probes: descend with the mind into the heart, and there call upon the name
keep the attention within the breast, at the place of the heart, and let the prayer rest there
the mind united with the heart, and warmth arose in that place
guard of the heart, and the return of the intellect into itself
with the breath draw the mind inward and hold it in the heart

systems.label: Boehme's forms and the Western esoteric body
probes: the seven forms or fountain spirits in man, each with its own quality and planet
the astral body and the elemental body, and the planets which rule the members
the salt, the sulphur and the mercury within the microcosm of man
the inward man has his own senses, and a light which is not of this world
the centre of nature turns within the heart of man, and the flash of fire arises

systems.label: Channels and points (control)
probes: the vital breath circulates through the channels and collaterals, gathering at the points
needle the point three inches below the knee to treat disorders of the stomach
the lung channel begins in the middle burner and descends to the thumb
the points along the spine correspond to the organs within
when the breath is blocked in the channel, pain and disease arise in that part
